text.formatted: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. _Hit:_ 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or become Poisoned for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target falls Unconscious for the same duration, or until it takes damage or another creature uses an action to shake it awake.
